newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate closes up on tight liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate closes up on tight liquidity.

text.p: Mexico's overnight Cetes rate MXAAB closed up 30 basis points at 29.70 percent due to lack of liquidity, traders said.
"Rates were under upside pressure. Even though Banco de Mexico injected a hefty amount of liquidity, demand for tax payments was heavy," a trader said.
Banco de Mexico injected a substantial 9.292 billion pesos in the secondary market by auctioning six credits, which it assigned at between 30.97 and 31.88 percent.
Liquidity was drained from the system by corporations paying tax bills, credit maturities and pre-weekend demand for cash.
Traders said that liquidity shortages could also have been due in part to the fact that banks need to settle balances outstanding on checking accounts they hold with the central bank next Wednesday.
Despite upside pressure on rates during the session, traders said they did not foresee any great changes in primary Cetes rates at next week's auction.
"The (bellwether) 28-day issue could be very stable with the rest falling, but by no more than 25 basis points," said a dealer.
Banco de Mexico assigned 28-day Cetes at 29.85 percent on Monday.
Traders said that inflation figures realeased during the session had no noticeable effect on trade as they were very close to expectations.

Banco de Mexico announced that consumer prices gained 0.89 percent during the first half of November, compared to an average forecast of 0.87 percent in a Reuters survey of financial professionals MXAAP.
Dealers noted that trade was thin due to interest among investors dwindling, as is often the case towards the end of a year.
"It's almost December and most have covered positions for the year. For the moment, dealers prefer to sit on the sidelines and it will stay that way throughout December," said a trader.
Overnight rates on bank paper meanwhile closed up 25 basis points at 30.75 percent.
Credit maturities for Monday were estimated at 4.837 billion pesos.
